reviews.title: Using for mining rig. Works fine for single program use.
reviews.comment: Purchased this for my 6 GPU mining rig. You don’t need a strong CPU for your rig. This works fine. Windows installed just fine, computer launches quick, and opening and downloading are fast as well. Running my mining software with no issues.
